~/.ferb/ferb.db
Tasks, conversations, results, spans, journal
Ledger, trail, memory, timers, schedules

div.style: color: rgb(50, 34, 65) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local files
activity/today.jsonl; memory exports; shell logs
Workspace and owner-requested artifacts

div.style: color: rgb(50, 34, 65) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Keychain / sealed credentials
Origin-bound secret fills
FERB identity and mailbox support

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Native host process ↔ FERB extension
Native messaging; extension 0.11.0 / protocol 6
Debugger / CDP, Accessibility + DOM references

div.style: color: rgb(59, 45, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Websites in selected profile
FERB profile or explicitly selected owner profile
Owned / borrowed / retained tabs

div.style: color: rgb(20, 38, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Codex CLI / Claude Agent SDK runtime
Decision calls: no action tools
Worker / checker: FERB MCP tools

div.style: color: rgb(20, 38, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ferb mcp stdio shim
Per-run token → daemon tools.list / tools.call

div.style: color: rgb(20, 37, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Authenticated Unix-socket RPC + event delivery
Chat, voice controller, questions, stop, notifications

div.style: color: rgb(20, 37, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Supervisor + WorkerRuns + runtime adapters
Plan → worker → inspect → cleanup → report
Recovery chooses next sequential attempt

div.style: color: rgb(20, 37, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Context + installed registry
Relevant memory, daily activity, chat / task history
Action discovery, worker types, live device facts

div.style: color: rgb(20, 37, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Action gateway + live execution state
Run tokens, schema / stop checks, locks, pending questions
Execute capabilities; redact, trace and ledger outcomes

div.style: color: rgb(20, 37, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Capability implementations / drivers
Browser bridge, Mac, shell, files
Owner questions, evidence, trail and time

div.style: color: rgb(20, 37, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Background services
Filtered activity watchers + memory distillation
Timers: reminders, worker sleep, scheduled requests

div.style: color: rgb(20, 37, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Persistence + observability services
SQLite stores, journal, spans, event bus
Daily activity mirror and task-result delivery

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owner interfaces
ferb CLI / chat
Optional signed FERB.app microphone client

div.style: color: rgb(59, 45, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Native macOS applications
Accessibility, AppleScript, screenshots
App/window-targeted keyboard and pointer input

div.style: color: rgb(59, 45, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Task-managed shell / PTY processes
Commands and requested coding-agent sessions
Independent of internal worker runtime
